venue.name: [University of California, Irvine](https://uci.edu)

information:
This competition is a series competition with [Marshall Middle Slice 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarshallMiddleSlice2022/).  Registrants will only be accepted to one competition.

If you are under the age of 18 by the date of the competition, your parents will need to fill out a minor waiver form. This form will be sent to the competitor's email closer to the date of the competition.

This competition is hosted by West Coast Cubing.
